      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Interpretable, well-separated industry categories that can be segmented and cross-tabulated against regional clusters; a classic company trait for explaining regional specialization."
    },
    {
      "name": "enterprise_vs_consumer_focus",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Clean, low-cardinality B2B/B2C/hybrid split that is easy to group on and compare across regions; an external associational trait."
    },
    {
      "name": "company_stage_signal",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Well-labeled maturity categories (established, growth, venture-backed, etc.) that support meaningful regional comparison; interpretable ordinal-ish segmentation."
    },
    {
      "name": "profitability_or_funding_model",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Interpretable funding-model categories, though it substantially overlaps with company_stage_signal (venture-backed vs bootstrapped), somewhat reducing marginal informativeness."
    },
    {
      "name": "service_delivery_model",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Distinct, interpretable delivery-model buckets; adds a business-model dimension, though it partially correlates with primary_sector and enterprise focus."
    },
    {
      "name": "cloud_native_architecture",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Clean binary trait that is interpretable and segmentable, but is a narrower/derivative signal that overlaps with service_delivery_model's cloud_saas category."
    }
  ],
  "n_predictors": 6,
  "relationship_informativeness": 0.72,
  "rationale": "All six columns are external, interpretable company traits with well-separated categories that can be grouped and cross-tabulated against regional_cluster, satisfying the EDA claim of opening informative, human-understandable relationships around the focus. None merely restate the geographic focus. The main weakness is redundancy: company_stage_signal and profitability_or_funding_model largely encode the same venture-backed-vs-established axis, and cloud_native_architecture overlaps with service_delivery_model's cloud_saas bucket, so as a set they cover fewer independent dimensions (sector, business orientation, maturity/funding, delivery model) than the count of columns suggests. Still, the set strongly supports discovering interpretable trait-to-region relationships."
}
